School
journal_pages.content:
Grainger Competition
We got knocked out of the competition. Kind of annoying not gonna lie. Not entirely sure why they did not accept the GP. It's fine. We continue to keep pushing ahead. I am not sure as of right now, but we didn't make the cut for some reason.


The print stopped half way..... had to spend an extra 1.5hrs here at IIT. It's fine, I'm in the Lab with Sasindu. Did some GP stuff. My HW is done and now I want to journal.


I officially begin work next week :D It's $17.05 D: but it's fine. Income is income at the end of the say and we just need to be making money. It's at school so it's an amazing oppurtunity!

journal_pages.name: Goose Project
journal_pages.content:
Finished the PCB today. Made Claude look it over many many times. Hopefully it's correct. Gonna be leaving here in ~10mins. The pieces are still printing. Once these are done, I'm gonna leave and head to the office. We really need a warehouse. Some space to work. For now this is fine.


I can see it happening. This project is only the beginning. Michael and I have too much grit to not get a warehouse. It's going to happen and we're going to have a lot of printers. Just gotta keep pushing!
